_note: Example team config. Copy it to ~/.collab-team/team.json (or create it with init.sh team) and rewrite it for your own members. init.sh uses it to generate collab/members.md for new projects and on team-sync, and the dispatch script reads its commands. In commands, {prompt} is the brief, {session} is the session ID and {last} is the file for the final reply.
dispatcher: <path to the dispatch script dispatch.py; delete this entry if you don't have one>

owner.duty: Sets direction, confirms decisions, rules on issues, and authorizes anything beyond a task card.
owner.wake: Ask directly in the conversation; anything that needs a decision goes into PROGRESS under "Needs your decision".

lead.name: Claude
lead.duty: Lead. Breaks work into tasks, writes task cards, picks people from the capability table and dispatches them, chairs meetings, integrates results, keeps the board up to date; never reviews work it coordinated itself.
lead.wake: Open a session in the project directory; this is the Owner's only conversation entry point.
lead.resume: Return to the same session; in a new session, read PROGRESS first.

members.name: Codex
members.permissions: Writes only to the working directory; never uses --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.
members.history: Codex desktop or its session logs.
